summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 17 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) scanner.go readLines never checks sc.Err(), so a transcript line over 8 MiB silently ends the read and under-counts usage. (2) apicover_named_test.go checks `r.Usage != (r.Usage)`, which compares a value with itself and can never fail. (3) fallbackchain_test.go hand-rolls an itoa that returns "" for negative numbers; use strconv.Itoa. (4) scanner_marker_test.go's jsonQuote escapes only quote, backslash and newline, so a tab produces invalid JSON. Its why-strings also cite stale lines: subagent.go:358 is now :354, and run.go:442 is now subagentrun/prompt.go:18. (5) In FillWarn, `pct == FillPctUnmeasured || pct < 0` has a redundant first half. (6) policy-config.md says only claude maps to a 200000 window, but codex, codex-tmux, agy and agy-tmux do too.
title: tokenusage: readLines ignores scanner errors, and one apicover test compares a value with itself
